trophies.name: A Quest for Strength Fulfilled
trophies.description: After countless battles and considerable struggle, you've arrived. Is this the end of your quest for strength? The answer...lies within.

trophies.name: Get Your Game Face On!
trophies.description: Where's your face, dingus? Get your butt to the avatar creator and sort yourself out! Crying shame we can't fix that attitude of yours while we're at it.

trophies.name: So This Is the Battle Hub...
trophies.description: Ah, yes. Welcome to the Battle Hub. I do not know what you seek, but please, enjoy yourself. That is the purpose for which it was built, after all.

trophies.name: First Encounters
trophies.description: Start by fighting a match in the Battle Hub. It doesn't matter if you win or lose. What matters is challenging yourself to take that first step.

trophies.name: There's Always Time for Training!
trophies.description: How's 30 matches in the Battle Hub sound? If yer not there yet, just keep at it! If ya wanna get sumo strong, ya can't be shy of the ring!

trophies.name: King of the Ring
trophies.description: Starting to get used to competition? Then set your sights on winning 30 Battle Hub matches. Gotta give yourself a challenge if you want to get anywhere in life.

trophies.name: Jungle-Sized Surprise
trophies.description: Ever hear of Extreme Battles? They're a little different from regular fights—a little more WILD. Try it out, and let your instincts take over!

trophies.name: Extreme Combat Training
trophies.description: If you can't adapt, you won't last five seconds on the battlefield. Fight 20 Extreme Battles. Perfect training to sharpen your judgement.

trophies.name: Over the Top Victory
trophies.description: 20 wins in Extreme Battle. Should be a snap for someone like you, yeah? Stomp this one flat, then aim for even greater heights! Bwahaha!

trophies.name: Becoming the Avatar
trophies.description: In Avatar Battles, you can battle others as an avatar―a self outside of your self. Go there, and experience all that such combat has to offer.

trophies.name: Fixin' for a Fight
trophies.description: Nothing gets my engine revving more than a brawl between avatars, live and in the flesh! Let's see you do 20 Avatar Battles!

trophies.name: The Struggle Over Self
trophies.description: An alternate form of combat, with an alternate path to victory. Get 20 wins in Avatar Battles. But don't obsess over the results. Let experience be your guide.

trophies.name: Gazing at the Peak
trophies.description: If you wanna match the one-and-only Jamie Siu, you'd better be early to the starting line. Give a Tournament a shot!

trophies.name: Steely Determination
trophies.description: The determination to stand in the ring and fight is what turns mind and muscle into tempered steel! Enter five Tournaments, and see for yourself!

trophies.name: Dominating Like a Ninja
trophies.description: Ninja can leap staircases in a single bound, but there's no skipping steps in training. Win 10 matches in a Tournament. It won't be easy, but you can do it.

trophies.name: Veteran of Battle
trophies.description: Kung fu is the result of ceaseless training. Do anything enough times, and you'll see results. So will you, once you fight in the Battle Hub 100 times.

trophies.name: Kickin' it Old School
trophies.description: Did you know you can play classic games at the Battle Hub Game Center? It's true! Cassette tapes and cartridges might be old...but they're still hecka rad.

trophies.name: Classic Leaderboard Champ
trophies.description: Ever try the Ranking Challenge at the Game Center? Give it a shot! It's important to always challenge yourself, even when it comes to games.

trophies.name: Entranced by Battle
trophies.description: Having an audience changes everything...and turns a mere fight into thrilling spectacle. Spectate a Battle Hub Match, and bear witness to glory.

trophies.name: Combat Analysis
trophies.description: In combat, you must constantly analyze the situation. Spectate an Extreme Battle, and hone your ability to read and react to the unexpected.

trophies.name: Watching Gets Me PUMPED!
trophies.description: Ah, there's nothing quite like a fight, one-on-one, in the flesh! If you wanna appreciate it too, go spectate an Avatar Battle!

trophies.name: Welcome to the Stable
trophies.description: Sounds like the Battle Hub has clubs you can join. Just like a sumo stable! You should join one! Ooh, I wonder if they have chanko stew...

trophies.name: Let the Praise Become Your Muscle
trophies.description: Hrrah! To fight before a cheering crowd is an honor shared by all wrestlers! Go on—try earning yourself a "Nice" fan of your own!

trophies.name: Gotta Be Popular! Uwo!
trophies.description: Uwo! My dream's to become famous, and make Mama proud! You should become famous too! Try sending or receiving 200 "Nice!" marks, for starters!

trophies.name: Spirits of Encouragement
trophies.description: Having outside support is a bit like having a spirit. You can't see them, but they lend you strength all the same. Send or receive 600 "Nice!" marks, and you'll feel strong too.

trophies.name: Pleased to Meet You!
trophies.description: I used to ask millions of questions as an agent. There's a lot you can learn from people just by talking to them—try chatting in the Battle Hub.

trophies.name: Coolheaded Analysis
trophies.description: Reviewing replay footage is a great way to learn from past fights. Watch with a calm, subjective eye, and you're bound to make some discoveries.

trophies.name: My Title, My Life
trophies.description: Earned any titles for your efforts yet? Me? Pfft. I don't need a title. I'm Jamie freakin' Siu!

trophies.name: Joining the Pack
trophies.description: A lone wolf is strong, but they're far more fearsome if they have a pack to call their own. So go on—try making some friends!

trophies.name: Fashion Leader
trophies.description: Clothing allows us to express ourselves. Know who else never changes their clothes? Animals. Change your outfit. Please.

trophies.name: Ready to Dance?
trophies.description: Have you had a chance to jam out at the DJ Booth in the Battle Hub, bud? Pick your favorite tunes, and light the dance floor aflame!

trophies.name: Up on the Big Screen
trophies.description: Sit down by the big monitor in the Battle Hub, and you can view all kinds of stuff. Man... Used to be me up there going wild on the big screen.

trophies.name: Neighborhood Peacekeeper
trophies.description: You gotta help people in need. I mean, that's the secret to keeping any city peaceful. So get out there and complete 22 sub-missions, got it?

trophies.name: Mastery's Bond
trophies.description: Once you find someone to call a master, you would do well to seek to deepen your bonds. Raise the bond with one of your masters to 100.

trophies.name: At Journey's End
trophies.description: Oh, you finished World Tour, did you? I suppose a word of congratulation is in order. I do hope your journey was a meaningful one.

trophies.name: Leaving the Nest
trophies.description: That's a wrap for basic training! You're a full-fledged fighting chickadee now, buddy. It's all up to you from here on out. Enjoy it!

trophies.name: Ha-dough-ken
trophies.description: I've worked a few odd jobs during my travels, and they all helped me with my training. You should take up a part-time job during your World Tour, as well.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.description: Something in the way while you're walking through the city? Here's an easy solution: send it flyin' with a Master Action! Mm-mm-mmm... It's the little pleasures in life.

trophies.name: The Grand Jeté of 100 Battles
trophies.description: Fight 100 online battles via Fighting Ground. What's that? Too difficult, you say? If you wish to take on the world, there can be no other path.

trophies.name: Tales of the Valiant
trophies.description: Gonna need ya to head to the Fighting Ground and finish Arcade Mode once, buddy! It's time ya heard the stories of your fellow fighters!

trophies.name: Practical Training
trophies.description: You've heard of combo trials, I presume? It's time you practice attack sequences. I want you to finish 45 of them. It will be difficult, but I've the utmost faith in you.

trophies.name: Fighting Fledgling
trophies.description: You know how a swallow can fly at speeds of up to 200 kilometers an hour? Well, even they were chicks once. It's all about practice! Get yourself to Training Mode!

trophies.name: Fighters' Codex
trophies.description: Whoa, you seen these Character Guide things? Talk about rad! They've got all kinds of info about people's fighting styles and moves. Oh yeah, Bushinryu gets some rep too, naturally.

trophies.name: Taking Initiative
trophies.description: You want to learn street fighting fundamentals? Well, too bad, 'cause I'm not in the mood to take on any students. Go hit the Tutorials, kid.

trophies.name: A Quest for Strength Fulfilled
trophies.description: After countless battles and considerable struggle, you've arrived. Is this the end of your quest for strength? The answer...lies within.

trophies.name: Get Your Game Face On!
trophies.description: Where's your face, dingus? Get your butt to the avatar creator and sort yourself out! Crying shame we can't fix that attitude of yours while we're at it.

trophies.name: So This Is the Battle Hub...
trophies.description: Ah, yes. Welcome to the Battle Hub. I do not know what you seek, but please, enjoy yourself. That is the purpose for which it was built, after all.

trophies.name: First Encounters
trophies.description: Start by fighting a match in the Battle Hub. It doesn't matter if you win or lose. What matters is challenging yourself to take that first step.

trophies.name: There's Always Time for Training!
trophies.description: How's 30 matches in the Battle Hub sound? If yer not there yet, just keep at it! If ya wanna get sumo strong, ya can't be shy of the ring!

trophies.name: King of the Ring
trophies.description: Starting to get used to competition? Then set your sights on winning 30 Battle Hub matches. Gotta give yourself a challenge if you want to get anywhere in life.

trophies.name: Jungle-Sized Surprise
trophies.description: Ever hear of Extreme Battles? They're a little different from regular fights—a little more WILD. Try it out, and let your instincts take over!

trophies.name: Extreme Combat Training
trophies.description: If you can't adapt, you won't last five seconds on the battlefield. Fight 20 Extreme Battles. Perfect training to sharpen your judgement.

trophies.name: Over the Top Victory
trophies.description: 20 wins in Extreme Battle. Should be a snap for someone like you, yeah? Stomp this one flat, then aim for even greater heights! Bwahaha!

trophies.name: Becoming the Avatar
trophies.description: In Avatar Battles, you can battle others as an avatar―a self outside of your self. Go there, and experience all that such combat has to offer.

trophies.name: Fixin' for a Fight
trophies.description: Nothing gets my engine revving more than a brawl between avatars, live and in the flesh! Let's see you do 20 Avatar Battles!

trophies.name: The Struggle Over Self
trophies.description: An alternate form of combat, with an alternate path to victory. Get 20 wins in Avatar Battles. But don't obsess over the results. Let experience be your guide.

trophies.name: Gazing at the Peak
trophies.description: If you wanna match the one-and-only Jamie Siu, you'd better be early to the starting line. Give a Tournament a shot!

trophies.name: Steely Determination
trophies.description: The determination to stand in the ring and fight is what turns mind and muscle into tempered steel! Enter five Tournaments, and see for yourself!

trophies.name: Dominating Like a Ninja
trophies.description: Ninja can leap staircases in a single bound, but there's no skipping steps in training. Win 10 matches in a Tournament. It won't be easy, but you can do it.

trophies.name: Veteran of Battle
trophies.description: Kung fu is the result of ceaseless training. Do anything enough times, and you'll see results. So will you, once you fight in the Battle Hub 100 times.

trophies.name: Kickin' it Old School
trophies.description: Did you know you can play classic games at the Battle Hub Game Center? It's true! Cassette tapes and cartridges might be old...but they're still hecka rad.

trophies.name: Classic Leaderboard Champ
trophies.description: Ever try the Ranking Challenge at the Game Center? Give it a shot! It's important to always challenge yourself, even when it comes to games.

trophies.name: Entranced by Battle
trophies.description: Having an audience changes everything...and turns a mere fight into thrilling spectacle. Spectate a Battle Hub Match, and bear witness to glory.

trophies.name: Combat Analysis
trophies.description: In combat, you must constantly analyze the situation. Spectate an Extreme Battle, and hone your ability to read and react to the unexpected.

trophies.name: Watching Gets Me PUMPED!
trophies.description: Ah, there's nothing quite like a fight, one-on-one, in the flesh! If you wanna appreciate it too, go spectate an Avatar Battle!

trophies.name: Welcome to the Stable
trophies.description: Sounds like the Battle Hub has clubs you can join. Just like a sumo stable! You should join one! Ooh, I wonder if they have chanko stew...

trophies.name: Let the Praise Become Your Muscle
trophies.description: Hrrah! To fight before a cheering crowd is an honor shared by all wrestlers! Go on—try earning yourself a "Nice" fan of your own!

trophies.name: Gotta Be Popular! Uwo!
trophies.description: Uwo! My dream's to become famous, and make Mama proud! You should become famous too! Try sending or receiving 200 "Nice!" marks, for starters!

trophies.name: Spirits of Encouragement
trophies.description: Having outside support is a bit like having a spirit. You can't see them, but they lend you strength all the same. Send or receive 600 "Nice!" marks, and you'll feel strong too.

trophies.name: Pleased to Meet You!
trophies.description: I used to ask millions of questions as an agent. There's a lot you can learn from people just by talking to them—try chatting in the Battle Hub.

trophies.name: Coolheaded Analysis
trophies.description: Reviewing replay footage is a great way to learn from past fights. Watch with a calm, subjective eye, and you're bound to make some discoveries.

trophies.name: My Title, My Life
trophies.description: Earned any titles for your efforts yet? Me? Pfft. I don't need a title. I'm Jamie freakin' Siu!

trophies.name: Joining the Pack
trophies.description: A lone wolf is strong, but they're far more fearsome if they have a pack to call their own. So go on—try making some friends!

trophies.description: Clothing allows us to express ourselves. Know who else never changes their clothes? Animals. Change your outfit. Please.

trophies.description: Sit down by the big monitor in the Battle Hub, and you can view all kinds of stuff. Man... Used to be me up there going wild on the big screen.

trophies.description: Fight 100 online battles via Fighting Ground. What's that? Too difficult, you say? If you wish to take on the world, there can be no other path.

trophies.description: Gonna need ya to head to the Fighting Ground and finish Arcade Mode once, buddy! It's time ya heard the stories of your fellow fighters!

trophies.description: You've heard of combo trials, I presume? It's time you practice attack sequences. I want you to finish 45 of them. It will be difficult, but I've the utmost faith in you.

trophies.description: You know how a swallow can fly at speeds of up to 200 kilometers an hour? Well, even they were chicks once. It's all about practice! Get yourself to Training Mode!

trophies.description: Whoa, you seen these Character Guide things? Talk about rad! They've got all kinds of info about people's fighting styles and moves. Oh yeah, Bushinryu gets some rep too, naturally.

trophies.name: Taking Initiative
trophies.description: You want to learn street fighting fundamentals? Well, too bad, 'cause I'm not in the mood to take on any students. Go hit the Tutorials, kid.

trophies.name: The Never-Ending Path
trophies.description: "Sweet! You got all the trophies! You're really somethin'. Isn't that right, Ryu?" "You have done well to reach the end of this one journey. The path to becoming a true fighter still lies ahead, but let us take time to share the joy of your accomplishment."

trophies.name: Mastering The Basics
trophies.description: Why don't you try finishing up the tutorial? You might've mastered the first step, but nailing down the fundamentals is what's important.

trophies.name: Your Story Starts Here
trophies.description: Your first goal for Story Mode is just to clear it once. You can probably guess, but I cleared it with Master Zangief first!

trophies.name: Lucky We Met!
trophies.description: Whoa, I'm really mixing it with the celebrities here! C'mon, Rashid, you're the Raging Storm! Get out there and finish 5 Character Stories!

trophies.name: The 16 Trials
trophies.description: So you wish to learn Yoga? If that is truly the case, then first you must complete the Character Story with all characters. There is great merit in walking each of their individual paths.

trophies.name: One Step Forward
trophies.description: If you're at a loss for what to do, why not raise a character to level 5? It should help you realize what you're missing.

trophies.name: Quantity Over Quality
trophies.description: Level up 5 characters! Up to level 5 should do the trick. When it comes to food and fightin', it's quantity over quality, mate.

trophies.name: No Rest For The Wicked
trophies.description: Your stats are as pitiful as your strength, maggot! Come back when you've raised all characters to level 5.

trophies.name: Slow But Steady Wins The Race
trophies.description: Your objective should be to raise a single character to level 30. There is great meaning in accomplishing what is difficult. To find your answer, you must set your sights high.

trophies.name: Vindicated Honor
trophies.description: Raise your player level to 50. Level up that much and you'll be about ready to exact you revenge.

trophies.name: Burning Spirit
trophies.description: Your player level is a reflection of your passion! Aim for the stars, and reach level 100!

trophies.name: Number 2 Is The New Number 1
trophies.description: Niiihehe! 2, 20, 200! Such a glorious sound, I could say it twice more! 200! Raise you player level to 200! I already have, niiihehe!

trophies.name: Make A Name For Yourself
trophies.description: Why don't you see if you can collect 10 titles? There's nothin' like a good title! Even Mel said they make me look cool!

trophies.name: Sultan Of Titles
trophies.description: I am Rashid of the Turbulent Wind! You can change how you feel, just with a title! If you had 30 of them, you'd be set for the rest of your life!

trophies.name: Fighting On The Internet
trophies.description: Alright, time you fought 10 network battles! The Internet is like my backyard - not a place I tend to lose! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: All Going To Plan!
trophies.description: Master Zangief! I fought in 50 network battles! The ring came to life with the clash of burning spirits! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: A Fiendish Trap
trophies.description: Impossible! You fought in 300 network battles? Well then, the time for you to witness my Psycho Power draws near. Mwahaha! (Excludes Battle Lounge)

trophies.name: Waiting Is Half The Fun
trophies.description: Patience is key to any warrior's training. Fight in network battles 30 times using the standby function. The longer you wait, the greater the joy will be when you finally get picked.

trophies.name: I Know Kung Fu!
trophies.description: Congratulations on your first win! Keep practicing your Kung Fu in those Ranked Matches and I know you'll only get better and better!

trophies.name: Addicted To Winning
trophies.description: It seems you've won 10 Ranked Matches. Never forget how it feels to win, or your future will soon be eclipsed by defeat.

trophies.name: Working Up An Appetite!
trophies.description: 30 Ranked Matches already? Lemme go catch up to that! Dinner always tastes better after you've pummeled a bunch of chumps!

trophies.name: Ceaseless Effort
trophies.description: Ah, your 100th Ranked Match victory. That look in your eyes tells me it was a fulfilling battle. Go forward one step at a time, and never forget this feeling.

trophies.name: Bam, Bam, Win!
trophies.description: Winning 300 matches will put the word out for Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu! It'll be like, "the succesor or Matsuda Jiu-Jitsu, Laura Matsuda is right here!"

trophies.name: Always Someone Stronger
trophies.description: Why not try fighting someone stronger than you in a Ranked Match? There's a lot you can gain from fighting stronger opponents. Beat 10 of 'em and you'll understand.

trophies.name: Savoring The Win Streak
trophies.description: Achieved three consecutive victories in Ranked Matches, have you? It appears you are getting a handle on your power. Maintain your modesty, and focus on your training; the path ahead is long.

trophies.name: First Promotion!
trophies.description: Master Zangief sent me flowers to celebrate me moving up a league for the first time! I can't read the card with all these tears!

trophies.name: Muscles Bring Victory!
trophies.description: Did you make it to Silver League?! Horosho! You have very good muscle! You can get much stronger from now!

trophies.name: Let's fight someone strong!
trophies.description: Finally, Golden League! There are so many potential rivals! Now the fun really begins!

trophies.name: Go Out With A Bang
trophies.description: "Finishing with an EX Special Move sure feels good, old man!" "You finally understand then, young one? How about you try doing it 300 times?" "Wha?! You know how many years that'll take?!"

trophies.name: Critical Beauty
trophies.description: 300 Critical Art finishes... It would seem a crimson rose that blooms within an ugly heart can still be beautiful...

trophies.name: Not Over 'Til It's Over
trophies.description: When you get that feeling like "I can't let it end like this!", that's when you should use a V-Reversal. Practice it 100 times, and then you'll be able to pull it off in your sleep!

trophies.name: Enlightenment
trophies.description: There is a power that resides deep within you. If you wish to know what that power is, trigger a V-Skill 100 times. Do so, and that power will belong to you.

trophies.name: Sudden Reversal
trophies.description: You know, the V-Trigger is pretty handy for shifting the flow of battle. You'll know just how effective it is once you've triggered it 100 times.

trophies.name: Playing Favorites
trophies.description: You must set a character as your favorite! Can't decide who to choose? Niiihehehe! Well, you can't go wrong with Lord Bison!

trophies.name: All In A Name
trophies.description: You'll never stand out without an original title. Try choosing an appropriate title for me.

trophies.name: Failing To Prepare Is Preparing To Fail
trophies.description: Collect 30 replays, kid. Once you've done your prep and know your opponent's weaknesses, you'll be in control of the fight. Don't risk your life by rushing in blind.

trophies.name: See You In My Dreams!
trophies.description: Visualization is a crucial skill, so try watching 50 replays! I watched so many, I started seeing Master Zangief in my dreams!

trophies.name: Not-So-Secret Admirer
trophies.description: When someone sets their sights on you, don't you just wanna try even harder? Add someone to your Favorites and see what happens!

trophies.name: Global Network
trophies.description: I have the direct lines for all the world's leaders recorded in my pocketbook. You should have 30 names in your Favorites at the very least.

trophies.name: Bodybuilding Is Life
trophies.description: Go try out Training Mode for 30 minutes! "Bodybuilding never let man down." I borrowed that one from Master Zangief!

trophies.name: Win Or Die Tryin'
trophies.description: It's about time you cleared Survival Mode on normal difficulty. You know what happens if you refuse, don't you? Let's just say the only way you live is if you keep on winning!

trophies.name: A True Warrior's Spirit
trophies.description: A warrior's soul is ri...ripened in Survival Mode. Emerge victorious on hard difficulty and you'll be ready for me to co...consume.

trophies.name: Back From Hell
trophies.description: Feel like taking the plunge into Survival Mode on extreme? Come back alive, and I'll grant you an audience with none other than me, the great Lord Bison!

trophies.name: Priceless
trophies.description: You managed to get 1,000,000 FM. That's pretty good! The real value, however, is in the path you walked to earn that much.

trophies.name: The outfit is the highlight of battle
trophies.description: The true crème de la crème know how to give spectators a good show. Now go and gain new colors for your outfit.

trophies.name: Zenith
trophies.description: Unlock all Trophies.

trophies.name: Title Idol
trophies.description: Obtain 300 Titles.

trophies.name: A Very Special Gift
trophies.description: Connect with 50 Special Moves.

trophies.name: Time For Some Fireworks!
trophies.description: Connect with 50 Launchers.

trophies.name: Anything Goes
trophies.description: Activate Cross Assault 50 times.

trophies.name: An Unknown Power
trophies.description: Activate Pandora 50 times.

trophies.name: Two Minds, Fighting As One
trophies.description: Connect with 50 Cross Arts.

trophies.name: Maelstrom Of Combos
trophies.description: Connect with 30 Quick Combos.

trophies.name: A Glimmering Light
trophies.description: Activate your Assist Gems 30 times.

trophies.name: Let's Heat Things Up!
trophies.description: Activate your Boost Gems 30 times.

trophies.name: Sturm und Drang
trophies.description: Finish a round with Cross Assault 30 times.

trophies.name: Power Consumes All
trophies.description: Finish a round with Pandora 30 times.

trophies.name: A Splendid Conclusion
trophies.description: Finish a round with a Super Art 30 times.

trophies.name: The Cross Revolution
trophies.description: Finish a round with a Cross Art 30 times.

trophies.name: A Perfect Victory!
trophies.description: Win a round without getting hit 30 times.

trophies.name: After The Dust Has Settled
trophies.description: Clear Arcade mode on Medium difficulty or higher.

trophies.name: Trail Of Ruined Dreams
trophies.description: Defeat 5 rival teams in Arcade mode on Medium difficulty or higher.

trophies.name: The Root Of Chaos
trophies.description: Defeat all of the bosses in Arcade mode on the hardest difficulty.

trophies.name: Just The Beginning
trophies.description: Clear one trial in Trial mode.

trophies.name: Trial Expert
trophies.description: Clear ten trials in Trial mode.

trophies.name: The Excellence of Execution
trophies.description: Clear 100 trials in Trial mode.

trophies.name: My Big First Step
trophies.description: Clear one lesson in the Tutorial.

trophies.name: Maturity Through Discipline
trophies.description: Clear all of the lessons in the Tutorial.

trophies.name: The First Mission
trophies.description: Clear one mission in Mission mode.

trophies.name: Mission Specialist
trophies.description: Clear all of the missions in Mission mode.

trophies.name: Fruits of Labor
trophies.description: Go into Training mode 3 times.

trophies.name: The Stones Guide Me
trophies.description: Customize a Gem Unit.

trophies.name: Doused In My Color!
trophies.description: Customize a character's color.

trophies.name: This Is How I Roll
trophies.description: Customize your player Title.

trophies.name: Here's My Shoutout
trophies.description: Customize your player comment.

trophies.name: The Warrior's Road
trophies.description: Fight 10 matches online.

trophies.name: The Crossroads of Tragedy
trophies.description: Fight 30 matches online.

trophies.name: The Harsh Road
trophies.description: Fight 50 matches online.

trophies.name: The Endless Road
trophies.description: Fight 100 matches online.

trophies.name: Learn The Fundamentals
trophies.description: Win 5 matches online.

trophies.name: Forge Your Own Path
trophies.description: Win 10 matches online.

trophies.name: Transcend All You Know
trophies.description: Win 50 matches online.

trophies.name: Your Legend Will Never Die
trophies.description: Win 100 matches online.

trophies.name: One Down!
trophies.description: Win in a Ranked Match.

trophies.name: To The Victor...
trophies.description: Raise your battle class rank for the first time in Ranked Match.

trophies.name: Proof Of Your Victory
trophies.description: Get to C rank for the first time in Ranked Match.

trophies.name: The Battle Never Ends
trophies.description: Win a match in Endless Battle.

trophies.name: Head Of The Dojo
trophies.description: Create a lobby in Endless Battle.

trophies.name: Observer
trophies.description: View 3 replays in the Replay Channel.

trophies.name: Evangelist Of The "X"
trophies.description: Have your replay downloaded 3 times in My Channel's Broadcast Mode.

trophies.name: Love Is Blind
trophies.description: Use a character in battle over 30 times.

trophies.name: Any Time, Any Place!
trophies.description: Use Arcade Fight Request 10 times.

trophies.name: It's Just For Research!
trophies.description: Access the Store.

trophies.name: Ten Down...
trophies.description: Win 10 consecutive Burst Kumite battles.

trophies.name: Magnanimity
trophies.description: Give 5 character color gifts.

trophies.name: Photo Op
trophies.description: Take a photo in the AR Gallery.

trophies.name: To the Victor Go the Spoils
trophies.description: Obtain a K.O. Monument.

trophies.name: Supersonic
trophies.description: Play the Sound Gallery 3 times.

trophies.name: Stories to Tell
trophies.description: Unlock every item in the Graphic Gallery.

trophies.name: On the Cutting Edge
trophies.description: Fight using Casual Style.

trophies.name: All Too Easy
trophies.description: Win by K.O. using Battle Tap.

trophies.name: Signs of Friendship
trophies.description: Fight in Ad Hoc Mode.

trophies.name: All Star
trophies.description: Use all characters.

trophies.name: I'm Just Getting Started!
trophies.description: Swap teams in Arcade Mode.

trophies.name: The Chosen Path
trophies.description: Win 30 consecutive Burst Kumite battles.

trophies.name: There Is Nothing More To Teach...
trophies.description: Completed every achievement. Now go save lives!

trophies.name: I Think I Got This
trophies.description: Perform a heart transplant.

trophies.name: Kali Mah!
trophies.description: Perform a heart transplant in under 1 minute 50 seconds.

trophies.name: Don't In-Test My Patience
trophies.description: Perform a double kidney transplant in under 3 minutes.

trophies.name: How Long Can You Live Without A Brain?
trophies.description: Perform a brain transplant in under 1 minute.

trophies.name: Blink And You'll Miss It
trophies.description: Perform an eye transplant in under 2 minutes and 30 seconds.

trophies.name: You May Feel A Light Tapping
trophies.description: Perform a teeth transplant in under 3 minutes.

trophies.name: Like a hotdog down a hallway.
trophies.description: Perform a corridor heart transplant.

trophies.name: Don't Even Need A Bucket
trophies.description: Perform a corridor heart transplant losing less than 900ml of blood

trophies.name: Tunnel Vision
trophies.description: Perform a corridor double kidney transplant losing less than 800ml of blood

trophies.name: The Brains Of The Operation
trophies.description: Perform a corridor brain transplant losing less than 750ml of blood.

trophies.name: Won't Even Need Glasses!
trophies.description: Perform a corridor eye transplant losing less than 1250ml of blood

trophies.name: Open Really Wide
trophies.description: Perform a corridor teeth transplant losing less than 550ml of blood

trophies.name: Nine Nine Nine!
trophies.description: Perform a heart transplant in an ambulance.

trophies.name: Life's Too Short
trophies.description: Perform a heart transplant in an ambulance in under 1 minutes 40 seconds.

trophies.name: A Surgeon's Merit Is Based On Speed
trophies.description: Perform a double kidney transplant in an ambulance in under 2 minutes.

trophies.name: Brainstorm
trophies.description: Perform a brain transplant in an ambulance in under 1 minute 30 seconds.

trophies.name: I Can See For Miles... Per Hour
trophies.description: Perform an eye transplant in an ambulance in under 2 minutes and 10 seconds.

trophies.name: Not The Time Or Place For Precision
trophies.description: Perform a teeth transplant in an ambulance in under 1 minute and 50 seconds.
